feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 November 2026 9:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 23 November 2026 at 9:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the east of the British Isles and low pressure to the west of Iceland bringing fronts across the area.


##Wind##

Southeast 4 to 6, increasing 6 or 7 overnight, then 7 or gale 8 early tomorrow morning. West and southern areas becoming cyclonic 3 to 5 early afternoon whilst remaining southeast 6 or 7 elsewhere, which will then decrease 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, soon becoming moderate or rough. Becoming moderate again in the evening tomorrow.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, heavy and persistent at times.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Cyclonic 3 to 5 in central to western parts but southeast 5 or 6 in the east at first, gradually becoming east or southeast 4 to 6 by Wednesday morning. Decreasing 4 or 5 by midday Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate, then slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, heavy and persistent at times, becoming fair Wednesday morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain at first becoming good later.
